intro: I’m Michael Ciccarelli, an independent software engineer working across design and development. I run [Third Index](https://thirdindex.co), building websites, applications, and digital products for clients, and [Halloran](https://halloran.company), where I build my own. My focus is frontend engineering, interaction, and design systems.
photos: Sometimes I play poker and take [photos](/photos).
